verdict.rationale: Salv documents domain-specific background automation. Users can configure clearance rules that auto-close alerts meeting set conditions, with an audit trail kept. Customers are re-screened automatically several times a day as lists change. Monitoring scenarios run with configurable thresholds and suppression intervals, and webhooks push events to client systems. There is no general-purpose, user-defined automation or workflow builder, and the AI component is explicitly informational only, never acting on its own. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable automation/workflow engine, autonomous AI-driven actions, scheduling controls beyond built-in re-screening, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
